F-RANDX19.draw_rule: Per attempt x = int(g.integers(0, 2^19)). Reject x < 1024 (degenerate), duplicates, and any x equal to an S3-PRIMARY x_R (recorded). Stratum: TWIST iff Tr(x + A + B / x^2) = 1; otherwise lift a point (x, y) and X2E iff [q](x, y) = O, else XE-NOT-2E. Cross-check: for x not TWIST, X2E iff Tr(x) = Tr(A) (C-TR19).
F-RANDX19.keep_rule: If the stratum already holds 200 unsatisfiable systems, record "quota_full" and skip. Otherwise classify s by oracle A and oracle B; s = 0 joins the stratum's arm. Satisfiable draws are recorded (s) and not processed further. Stop when all three strata hold 200. Cap 30000 attempts.

N-AFF19.draw_rule: First, for d = 1..5 in order: E'^0 = zeros(19 * 211), E'^0[flatnonzero(E^0)] = g.integers(0, 2, size), then for j = 0..18 in order E'^j = zeros, E'^j[flatnonzero(E^j)] = g.integers(0, 2, size). Then family d is evaluated at r(x_R) for the non-degenerate S3-PRIMARY attempts in draw order (both strata): system = E'^0 xor (xor over j with r_j = 1 of E'^j).
N-AFF19.keep_rule: Per family, reject duplicates, compute s exhaustively, keep the first 40 with s = 0 and the first 10 with s >= 1. If the primary attempts run out first, the shortfall is recorded. Pooled arm: up to 200 unsatisfiable and 50 satisfiable; every statistic is also reported per family.

N-CONV19.draw_rule: per attempt bits = g.integers(0, 2, size=|S_L|) (one call), placed on S_L; every other column 0..20 is zero.
N-CONV19.keep_rule: Per slot, attempts 0..255. Reject a draw equal to E_S3(x_R) (identity) or equal to an already-kept system of the arm (duplicate, by E_sha256). Compute s exhaustively. The first s = 0 draw is the slot's UNSATISFIABLE system; for slots 0..49 the first s >= 1 draw is its SATISFIABLE CONTROL. Stop when the slot's roles are filled. A role unfilled after attempt 255 is EXHAUSTED(cap): recorded, never a result, and it reduces the arm's denominator.
N-CONV19.slots: the 200 lowest-draw-order S3-U400 systems, slot i = S3-U400:i

N-ELL19.draw_rule: RT-20260924-d95e70 j9-ptm/o2-declaration.yaml `draw`, at n = 19: M = zeros(19 * 211); M[Upos] = g.integers(0, 2, size=Upos.size); c = int(g.integers(0, 2)); rows 0..17 kept; row 18 REPLACED by ell_lin + c, where ell_lin is the linear part of S_3's ell at n = 19 as determined by C-ELL0 (expected v_0 + v_10).
N-ELL19.keep_rule: Stream mode. Reject duplicates. Compute s exhaustively. Keep the first 200 draws with s = 0 and the first 50 with s >= 1. Cap 20000 draws; a shortfall is recorded and reduces the denominator.

N-F219.draw_rule: M = zeros(19 * 211); M[Upos] = g.integers(0, 2, size=Upos.size) (the F-NULLF2 construction of EXP-CERTBIN-4e92d7 at n = 19).

S3-PRIMARY.draw_rule: Stage-1 target rule (EXP-CERTBIN-4e92d7 object.subgroup_points) with the literal P, Q: per attempt a = int(g.integers(0, q)), b = int(g.integers(0, q)); R = [a]P + [b]Q; if R = O reject (R_is_O). x_R = x(R). If x_R < 1024 (x_R in V, including 0) it is DEGENERATE: recorded and excluded. A repeated x_R is rejected (duplicate). Every other attempt is classified by oracle A and oracle B (C-ORACLE).
S3-PRIMARY.keep_rule: The first 400 attempts with s = 0 form S3-U400 (the primary arm), in draw order. The first 100 attempts with s >= 1 form S3-SAT100. Stop at the 400th unsatisfiable attempt (S3-SAT100 is always filled first in expectation; if not, continue until it is, without adding to S3-U400). Cap: 5000 attempts; a shortfall is recorded, never redrawn, and reduces N.

executor_interpretations: E_sha256 = sha256 of the compact JSON list of the 19 lowercase E_hex strings.
S3-PRIMARY duplicate = x_R equal to that of an earlier classified attempt; the loop stops when both quotas are full (checked before each attempt).
N-CONV19 duplicate = equal to an already-kept N-CONV19 system; the generator is consumed slot by slot.
N-ELL19 / N-F219 duplicate = equal to an earlier non-duplicate draw of the same stream.
N-AFF19 'non-degenerate S3-PRIMARY attempts' = the classified attempts (R != O, x_R >= 1024, not a duplicate), in draw order; duplicates are per family.
F-RANDX19 rejection order: degenerate, duplicate (of any earlier non-degenerate draw), S3-PRIMARY collision (any primary attempt with R != O).
Instance key = '<ARM>:<i>' with i the running index of the kept system within the arm in keep order (pooled over roles, families and strata); role, slot, family and stratum are separate fields.
C-NONREF control set = the first 5 (by key order) unsatisfiable systems W_4 does not refute in each of N-CONV19, N-ELL19, N-F219, N-AFF19 and F-RANDX19.
C-BACKEND / C-LIT 'every arm' = S3-U400, N-CONV19, N-ELL19, N-F219, N-AFF19 and each F-RANDX19 stratum.
generator_rule: One numpy.random.Generator(numpy.random.PCG64(seed)) per arm, numpy 2.4.6 (DEC-20260923-4d7a19 R-2), consumed in the order stated. No other call touches it. Arms are independent streams.
